main_text.p: municatos denunciamus etiã in his scriptis. Et ut ista præmissa, omnibus in Christo credentibus innotescat, uestræ fraternitati committimus, & commendamus, quatenus præfatum dominum Ioannem Oldcastel lum, sicut præmittitur, per nos fuisse & esse damnatum hæreticum, schismaticum, & in articulis supra scriptis errantem, omnesque alios, & singulos, qui eundem dominum Iohannem de cetero in sui fauore erroris receptauerit, defensauerit, receptauerint uel defensauerint, aut sibi auxilium, consilium uel fauorem in hac parte præbuerit uel præbuerint, tanquam receptatores, fautores & defensatores hæreticorum, per dictam uestram sententiam diffiniti-uam excommunicatos, in ecclesia uestra, per uestras ciuitates & dioceses, per singulos subditos uestros curatos earundem, in ecclesiis suis, cum maior in eisdem affuerit popu-

page.notes: Catchword and the lone letter below the text read as printed; "P" is a signature-like mark. Some long s forms rendered as plain s; words such as "innotescat" and "fauorem" are partly obscured in the scan and may be imperfect.
